scope.summary: Qualify BodyPose and interlink unit, axis, skeleton, camera, contact, and animation round trips through the initial Blender and Unreal production profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Invokes the pinned Blender and Unreal import/round-trip tools for every required row, records exact tool/importer versions, commands, exit state, receipts, artifacts, and opened visual captures, and fails rather than skips when a required DCC tool is unavailable.

Pins unit/axis/handedness, skeleton/rest-pose, animation timebase/interpolation, camera intrinsics/extrinsics, and pose tolerance/loss policy per lane; BodyPose/contact sidecars are content-hash-associated with the exported asset and verified on reimport.

Required fixtures cover single and multi-actor poses, unusual proportions, IK pins/contacts, camera reprojection, correctives, root motion, negative scale/unit/axis cases, and deterministic re-export.

Each verdict opens the exact exported and reimported artifact against the exact pinned reference and records quantitative tolerances plus visual evidence; synthetic or self-comparison-only rows cannot pass.

Consumes the signed MT-736 toolchain lock: Blender 4.5 LTS and Unreal Engine 5.8 are the initial version families, and the exact patch/build/importer/plugin ids plus binary/package sha256 must be non-placeholder and match the invoked tools.
Every cloth/body/camera/contact/animation/import/export boundary in this proof consumes MT-656 typed units exactly once and includes negative mixed-unit and double-conversion rows.
scope.risk_if_missed: Schema-only round trips can pass while Blender or Unreal changes scale, axes, rest pose, contacts, or animation in ways that break professional production.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior is observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; the owning native-shell MT verifies GUI projection.

target_entries: Tailor model manual > Required Blender and Unreal round trips

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT emits or projects its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; use its open projection contract and do not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
